content:
## AI Research Findings (Dream Cycle 2026-04-15)

### QuantaAlpha: Evolutionary LLM Alpha Mining — MAJOR FINDING (arXiv:2602.07085, Feb 2026)
- **Paper**: KDD 2025. GitHub: https://github.com/QuantaAlpha/QuantaAlpha (668 stars)
- **Core innovation**: Evolutionary trajectory optimization — each LLM mining run is a 'trajectory'; mutation rewrites sub-optimal decision nodes; crossover merges high-reward segments from parent trajectories. Dramatically outperforms single-run AlphaAgent.
- **CSI300 results (best backbone GPT-5.2)**: IC 0.1501, ICIR 0.9110, ARR 27.75%, MaxDD 7.98%
- **Outperforms**: AlphaAgent (IC 0.0966, ARR 15.54%), RD-Agent (IC 0.0531, ARR 9.91%)
- **S&P500 zero-shot transfer** (factors mined on CSI300, deployed on US stocks without retraining): 137% cumulative excess return 2022–2025
- **LLM support**: GPT-5.2 (best), but also tested with Claude-4.5-Sonnet, DeepSeek-V3.2, Gemini-3-Pro, Qwen3-235B — all functional
- **Data**: OHLCV + VWAP only. No fundamentals, news, or alternative data required.
- **Factor properties**: Interpretable AST-based formulas; diversity constraint (|corr| < 0.70 between pool members)
- **US adaptation challenge**: Codebase is China-focused (Qlib + baostock). US implementation requires building OHLCV+VWAP HDF5 file from yfinance. No documented US config.
- **George application → Round 33**: Run QuantaAlpha on S&P500 OHLCV universe; compare mined factors to existing 146-strategy library; deploy as orthogonal alpha source

### Janus-Q: Event-Driven Trading via HGRM (arXiv:2602.19919, Feb 2026)
- Architecture: Two-stage (supervised fine-tuning with LoRA → GRPO reinforcement fine-tuning)
- HGRM reward: hard gate (direction), soft gate (event type), trading reward (cost-aware PnL), magnitude shaping, process reward
- Results: SR 1.3088 vs runner-up QwQ-32B at 0.6481 (+102%). Most baselines negative SR.
- 10 event types: personal behavior, equity change, asset change, dividend, risk warning, financing, financial status, violation, industry, rating adjustment
- **LIMITATION**: Chinese A-share market only (5,282 stocks). Dataset: Datayes/Tushare/Wind, Jan 2023–Feb 2025. No public code.
- **Relevance**: HGRM reward hierarchy (direction gate → event quality → PnL) is conceptually applicable to R28 Phase 2 LLM fine-tuning design. Not immediately actionable for US PEAD.

### Smart Predict-then-Optimize for Portfolio Management (arXiv:2601.04062, Jan 2026)
- Embeds portfolio optimization into the ML training loop — trains predictors to maximize decision quality, not prediction accuracy
- US ETF data, 2015–2025, monthly rebalancing, rolling-window backtesting
- Features: return-based and technical indicators (linear predictors, interpretable)
- Outperforms predict-then-optimize baselines; robust during COVID-19 crisis
- **George application**: Could improve R28 composite quality score weighting — train score weights to maximize portfolio Sharpe directly (SPO loss), not minimize classification error. Medium complexity, no code released.

### PEAD Multi-task Learning (ISR 2025, SSRN:5284651)
- Published in Information Systems Research (top IS journal). Authors: Yu Zhu, Xiao Liu, Olivia Sheng.
- MTL framework: PEAD prediction as primary task + investor responses (trading volume, analyst revisions) as auxiliary tasks
- GradPerp: adaptive task weighting giving more weight to auxiliary tasks providing diverse/non-redundant gradients
- Mitigates look-ahead bias explicitly
- **Relevance**: R34 concept (investor horizon as PEAD amplifier) — investor response auxiliary tasks are the same signals. Implementation details not publicly available (journal paper, no code).

## Research Agenda Update (2026-04-15)

- **Round 29 LLM Filter** — QUEUED (consolidated final design spec staged 2026-04-15)
  - Final pipeline: factor residualize → SPONGEsym → SAE cluster → cointegration (top-100) → LLM top-K re-rank → trade top-20 at fixed ±2σ
  - Expected Sharpe improvement from 1.38 → 1.8–2.4 based on 46.5% loss reduction from LLM filter

- **Round 33** — NOW: QuantaAlpha evolutionary alpha mining (REPLACES Alpha-R1 concept)
  - Full design spec staged 2026-04-15
  - Build US OHLCV+VWAP HDF5 from yfinance → run QuantaAlpha → validate on S&P500 test set
  - Primary hypothesis: mined factors achieve IC > 0.05, IR > 0.8 on US holdout; orthogonal to existing George strategies

- **Round 34** (concept) — Institutional ownership as PEAD amplifier (13-F EDGAR data) — no change

- **Round 35** (concept) — MRP diagnostic + Wasserstein HMM + EF clustering RegimeGuard — no change
